item.title: Anaheim Ducks Recall Moore and Washe From San Diego
item.description: The Anaheim Ducks announced today that the National Hockey League (NHL) club has recalled defenseman Ian Moore and center Tim Washe from the San Diego Gulls, Anaheim’s primary development affiliate in the American Hockey League (AHL). Moore, 24 (1/4/02), has recorded 2-7=9 points with 18 penalty minutes (PIM) in 41 games with the Ducks this season, scoring his first career NHL goal Nov. 6 at Dallas. item.title: San Diego Guls Recall Coulson Pitre and Roman Kinal From Tulsa
item.description: The San Diego Gulls announced today that the American Hockey League (AHL) club has recalled forward Coulson Pitre and defenseman Roman Kinal from Tulsa (ECHL). Pitre, 21 (12/13/2004), has appeared in 11 games this season for San Diego totaling 1-1=2 points. In 26 games for Tulsa this season, Pitre collected 5-16=21 points. item.title: Gulls Late Rally Not Enough to Beat Barracuda
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls fell to the San Jose Barracuda tonight after a late rally was not enough to take over the lead at Tech CU Arena, 3-2. Tomas Suchanek took over in the crease early in the first period after Calle Clang made an early departure from the game. Suchanek faced 26 total shots, allowing only two through to keep San Diego in the game. The Barracuda found three goals before the Gulls were able to put some pressure on in the third period.
